تعتذري (form VIII)
# تَعْتَذِرِي (taʕtaḏirī) /taʕ.ta.ði.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# تُعْتَذَرِي (tuʕtaḏarī) /tuʕ.ta.ða.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
